messages.text: Thursday, September 24 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn's first crisp air, jazz notes, and a town's future
A mostly clear Thursday arrives with crisp autumn air and a high near 70°F. Look for jazz performances in Ann Arbor and discussions on Ann Arbor's downtown property sale.
Expect a mostly clear day with a high near 70°F and a low around 51°F, with no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:24 AM and sunset is at 7:27 PM, with the moon appearing as a waxing gibbous, 93.4% illuminated.
Ann Arbor's evening sounds and sights
For a taste of jazz, consider Fresh Berrys. at El Limon at 6:00 PM, or Pianist Barron Ryan at Kerrytown Concert House at 7:30 PM.
Evil Gigawatt's birthday is today, September 24.
Ann Arbor plans for downtown property sale funds
Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the $14.2 million to $17.4 million expected from the sale of the city-owned Kline’s lot. The funds will be allocated to 12 different projects.
Friday brings film and music
Tomorrow, catch a free outdoor screening of 'Best in Show' at Campus Martius Park in Detroit, or attend Dolly Day at the Ann Arbor District Library.
Satellites navigate without GPS, new cancer treatment advances

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and star catalogs. The University of Michigan has established a $10 million Histotripsy Center to advance non-invasive cancer treatments using soundwaves.
The Starship launch schedule is unset, with no official date listed for its next attempt.
A clear sky offers many paths to discovery.
Friday, September 25 · Canton, Michigan
Full Moon Rises Over Overcast Autumn Skies

An overcast but mild autumn day is here, with a full moon rising this evening. Locally, Ann Arbor is exploring ways to spend millions from a downtown property sale, while science reports on NASA's autonomous satellite navigation.
Today will be overcast with a high near 69°F and a low around 46°F, with a minimal chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:25 AM and sunset at 7:26 PM, with the full moon rising at 6:51 PM, 97.6% illuminated.
Friday's Nearby Entertainment

Consider the "Dolly Day" celebration at the Ann Arbor District Library Downtown Branch starting at 5:30 PM for crafts and music. For evening entertainment, the Windsor International Film Festival is offering a free outdoor screening of "Best in Show" at Campus Martius Park in Detroit at 7:00 PM.
The next significant calendar item is tomorrow's "BIG READ KICKOFF" event at the YDL-Michigan Library Plaza in Ypsilanti at 11:00 AM.
Ann Arbor City Council Approves Spending for Downtown Property Sale

Ann Arbor City Council has approved a plan to allocate between $14.2 million and $17.4 million from the sale of the Kline's lot. The funds will support 12 different projects, including affordable housing and sustainable energy initiatives.
Tomorrow and Beyond

Tomorrow, the Ypsilanti community can engage with "The Big Read" kickoff at the YDL-Michigan Library Plaza at 11:00 AM. For music lovers, The Ark in Ann Arbor features multiple performances, including The Bros. Landreth at 7:30 PM and Devon Gilfillian at 8:00 PM.
Satellites Navigate Autonomously Without GPS

NASA's Starling satellites have successfully demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and a catalog of space objects. Additionally, the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has cleared its flight-readiness review, moving closer to launch preparations.
Starship's next launch is not officially scheduled, with independent estimates suggesting no earlier than September 18, 2026.
The quiet hum of the day holds its own particular grace.
